notes.title: Season 7 - NBA 2K25
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VcajEaInuuk;full][/previewyoutube]

Jalen Brunson plays hard until the clock strikes double zeroes. Starting May 16, leave it all on the floor during Season 7 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i] and do whatever it takes to power your squad to victory in The City. Draw inspiration from the NBA’s Clutch Player of the Year and compete across [i]NBA 2K25[/i]’s immersive game modes to earn XP and level up.

Season 7 features exciting new MyCAREER and MyTEAM rewards, from new cosmetics to flex in The City to potent 100 OVR and Invincible cards to dominate Triple Threat Park. Level up the Season rewards ladder to claim it all and add even more to your collection with the Season 7 Pro Pass*. Playoff basketball is here and it’s time to add to your Hall of Fame resume with some unforgettable NBA Finals highlights.

[h2][b]MyCAREER[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/cf7b699676bead4f3cd065a9455eb32165c97068.jpg[/img]

Jalen Brunson’s star continues to shine brighter. The New York Knicks superstar is adding to his playoff resume with big-time shots on the sport’s biggest stage. Channel his clutch gene during Season 7 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i] and deliver some iconic moments of your own in MyCAREER. Watch the clock tick down with the ball in your hands and quiet the crowd with game-winning plays. Showcase your MyPLAYER’s offensive prowess in The City and compete to earn XP so you can level up and claim all-new rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/808ef9564bcfbe0caa168982a15b5e1ca2159a93.jpg[/img]

Check out some of the rewards available during Season 7:

[list][*] Level 14 Dune Buggy
[*] Level 20 ‘Chuck the Condor’ - Los Angeles Clippers Mascot
[*] Level 21 15% REP Boosted REC Headband Tie
[*] Level 23 Multicolored Hairstyle
[*] Level 30 Tier 1 ‘Max +1’ Badge Perk
[*] Level 32 ‘Time’ Teammote
[*] Level 36 Wilson X NBA City Basketball
[*] Level 38 Sun Hat
[*] Level 39 Underground Outfit
[*] Level 40 +1 Cap Breaker[/list]
Answer the call to greatness during Season 7 and produce memorable moments in the clutch, as you earn XP and level up to receive all-new MyCAREER rewards. Enjoy the next six weeks of NBA Playoff action in The City and The Neighborhood, and prepare for a champion to be crowned.

[h2][b]MyTEAM[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/490bf351dad71ff548de778cd7758527e606318b.jpg[/img]

Come up clutch in Season 7 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i] and stunt with a host of all-new MyTEAM cards, including a [b]Level 1 Pink Diamond Donovan Mitchell[/b] evolution card and a handful of New York Knicks stars. The Pink Diamond Mitchell card can be evolved to a 99 OVR Dark Matter by completing his impressive feat of 71 points in a game. Unleash the Cleveland Cavaliers’ all-star in single-player and multiplayer game modes, as you earn XP and climb the Season rewards ladder to unlock new cards.

Reach Level 18 and receive a Dynamic Duo featuring [b]Dark Matter Jalen Brunson[/b]—from the All-Star Pack—and [b]Diamond Josh Hart[/b]—from the Mic Drop Pack. Because this is a Dynamic Duo set, pair the “’Nova Knicks” together on the court and both Brunson and Hart boost to 99 OVR Dark Matter cards. Close out fourth quarters in style with the 2025 NBA Clutch Player of the Year, Jalen Brunson, and his do-it-all teammate to leverage years of collegiate and professional chemistry on the court. 

Round out your 3v3 Knicks lineup with [b]Level 20 Dark Matter Amar’e Stoudemire[/b], one of the most esteemed New York big men in franchise history. The former goggle-wearing power forward boasts a knock-down mid-range game and is explosive around the basket. Put Stoudemire in pick-and-roll situations with Brunson and let your opponents pick their poison as you dissect their defense. It would’ve been fun to watch Stoudemire and Brunson play together during the same era, but you can make it happen in MyTEAM.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/2b1788abd63a37e92ee4977ed65f151f2d807ddc.jpg[/img]

Season 7 is giving the Knicks a lot of love, with Brunson, Hart, Stoudemire, and [b]Level 30 100 OVR Willis Reed[/b], but this Season closes out with a player from an Eastern Conference rival. Climb your way to Level 40 and earn the [b]Invincible Paul George[/b] card, and recreate some of his most electrifying moments as an Indiana Pacer in his No. 24 jersey. Combine Season 7’s featured players together to create a formidable lineup of Eastern Conference All-Stars.

Here are some other available rewards during Season 7:

[list][b][*] Level 25 99 OVR Premium Pack
[*] Level 31 Deluxe Pack Door Game
[*] Level 37 99+ OVR Premium Option Pack
[*] Level 38 Legend Badge[/b][/list]
Assemble Eastern Conference stars and New York Knicks legends during Season 7, and wreak havoc in 3v3 or 5v5 game modes as you battle for MyTEAM supremacy.

[h2][b]THE W ONLINE**[/b][/h2]

The WNBA is so back! A’ja Wilson, Sabrina Ionescu, Angel Reese, Caitlin Clark, and a new rookie class led by phenom Paige Bueckers are ready to compete for a shot at the WNBA Championship Trophy. A new era of WNBA basketball is dawning this season and with plenty of new faces in new places, there’s no shortage of storylines heading into season tip-off May 16. Celebrate the start of the 2025 season by hitting the hardwood in The W, featuring all-new Season 7 Weekly and Seasonal rewards.

Take a look at some of the rewards below: 

[b]Weekly Rewards[/b]

[list][*] Gemini Top + Necklace
[*] Historic Team Breakthrough Sleeves
[*] Rainbow Themed Sleeves
[*] W Race Helmet
[*] Cancer Top + Necklace[/list]
[b]Season Rewards[/b]

[list][*] Atlanta Dream Ball
[*] Atlanta Dream Jersey Card
[*] Clothing Bundles
[*] Breakthrough Sleeve
[*] Badge Perks
[*] Candace Parker Game Changer Jersey
[*] Los Angeles Sparks Say Her Name Jersey[/list]
Team up with other players and complete all-new challenges to contribute toward the Season 7 Community Goal, and make sure you tune in for WNBA opening night!

[h2][b]SEASON 7 PRO PASS[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/593efb2c88f07857dfaefc7c6fe3a7cd2047c564.jpg[/img]

Make sure you’re stylin’ and profilin’ in Season 7 with the Pro Pass. Stay fresh with the latest and greatest gear so you can look good, feel good, and play good. Chase 40 additional MyCAREER and MyTEAM rewards, including consumables, cosmetics, and cards. Reap some of the rewards instantly with coveted automatic items, before beginning your pursuit of the other 40 rewards.

Season 7 Automatic Rewards:

[list][b][*] Animated Lava Lamp Head
[*] Bronze Patterned Boxing Robe
[*] 100 OVR Zion Williamson
[*] Season 7 Pro Pass Pack[/b][/list]
Clown the competition on the court and with Season 7 Pro Pass cosmetics, like the Level 7 Clown Facepaint. Add even more earnable rewards to your collection with 40 additional tiers, featuring skins, Premium Packs, and MyTEAM cards. Pair 100 OVR Zion Williamson with Level 40 Pro Pass Invincible Paul George—with an alternate No. 13 jersey—and bolster the wing with lengthy, athletic playmakers. Check out some of the other notable Season 7 Pro Pass rewards below:

[list][b][*] Level 3 Blue Checkered Jean Shorts
[*] Level 6 Clown Facepaint
[*] Level 12 Camo Bonnet
[*] Level 19 Galaxy Opal Coach Mike D’Antoni
[*] Level 25 99+ OVR Premium Option Pack (Pick 2)
[*] Level 28 Legend Badge Option Pack (Pick 3)
[*] Level 30 ‘Bango the Buck’ - Milwaukee Bucks Mascot
[*] Level 37 100 OVR Premium Pack
[*] Level 39 Underground Outfit: Inferno Variant
[*] Level 40 Pro Pass Invincible Paul George (No. 13 Version)[/b][/list]
Get the most out of your Season 7 experience with the NBA 2K25 Season Pro Pass. To learn more about the Pro Pass, visit the official FAQ page.

[i]*NBA 2K25 Season 7 Season Pass FREE rewards require unlocking with gameplay. NBA 2K25 Pro Season Passes and Hall of Fame Passes are available for separate purchase and require base game, internet connection and NBA 2K Account. Paid premium Passes unlock additional rewards for the Season that are earnable through gameplay. Progress and rewards reset at the end of each Season. For more information on Season Pass, go to https://nba.2k.com/2k25/season-pass-faq/[/i]

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=e2DYtY0p0LI;full][/previewyoutube]

Blessed with electrifying athleticism, an unguardable jumpshot, and the clutch gene, Tracy McGrady was known for shredding defenses during his prime. For Season 6 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i], harness T-Mac’s offensive prowess and prolific scoring to light up the box score and earn XP, so you can climb to the top of the Season rewards ladder.

Rise above the competition in The City as you complete challenges in MyCAREER and MyTEAM. Experience a wide array of activities and participate in new events throughout the course of Season 6.

[h2][b]MyCAREER[/b]
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/d3684468145fa0c8c1a15430b1a5a9f10e15051d.jpg[/img]
From a top-10 draft pick to the NBA Hall of Fame, Tracy McGrady captivated the world during his ascent from phenom to legend with unbelievable performances and effortlessly smooth mid-range shots, rivaling other NBA superstars during the 2000s. T-Mac’s superhuman talent inspired a generation of hoopers to recreate his game-winning buzzer-beaters and fill the stat sheet—now it’s your turn.

This Season, will your team to victory, with clutch shots like T-Mac, and carry your squad into the postseason with hopes of capturing an NBA title in MyCAREER. Put your MyPLAYER’s offensive arsenal on full display in The City and take aim at a host of all-new rewards in Season 6.

Check out some of the rewards available during Season 6:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/a9a0e7bab0aab5fd08fa3f232f03bad68486f6be.jpg[/img]
● Level 12 Rainbow Eyes
● Level 16 What ya Gonna do Teammote
● Level 20 Crunch Minnesota Timberwolves Mascot
● Level 21 Boosted REC Socks (15% REP Bonus)
● Level 23 Dreads with Jewelry
● Level 32 Love for Me Teammotes (NG)
● Level 36 Historic NBA Jersey
● Level 38 Cargo Shorts
● Level 39 Hooded Stealth Figure
● Level 40 +1 Cap Breaker (NG)

Show no mercy during Season 6 and take down anyone who stands in your way, then dance on ‘em with your brand new Teammote. This Season boasts more exciting rewards, new upcoming events, and endless competition in The City and The Neighborhood. Take part in all of the fun for the next six weeks and rack up XP in MyCAREER and MyTEAM.

[h2][b]MyTEAM[/b]
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/0b6cccbfa01a0f6b43656895f606b022c34c219d.jpg[/img]
Create MyTEAM magic in Season 6 with NBA legends and gifted playmakers, like Level 1 Diamond Luka Dončić. The Los Angeles Lakers guard is known for leaving spectators in awe with his sensational skills. Use “Luka Magic’s” wizardry to dupe defenders and set up spectacular alley-oops and other unbelievable finishes. The Level 1 Diamond Luka Dončić card is also an evo card, capable of being leveled up to a Pink Diamond by completing a series of goals.

Dončić has been outspoken about his love of playing alongside a lob threat, and Level 10 Pink Diamond Robert Williams III fits the bill. Williams can be used as a big, physical body in the paint with exceptional athleticism to either leap to catch a well-placed lob or contest layups on the defensive end as a rim-protecting human fly swatter. Insert Williams into a 3-man lineup or 5-man lineup and give your squad a powerful center.

Before he shared the backcourt with T-Mac for four seasons in Houston, Rafer Alston was a streetball legend in New York, known for carving up defenders with ease. This Season, recreate some of “Skip to My Lou’s” deceptive crossovers with the Level 20 Galaxy Opal Rafer Alston card and supplement your offense with an elite ball-handler and productive scorer. He may have deferred to T-Mac at one point, but he’s more than capable of commanding the spotlight on his own.

Only 45 rookies have been named to the NBA All-Star team in league history, and Grant Hill is one of them. Hill entered the league with as much promise as any prospect and he delivered, earning Rookie of the Year honors and making seven All-Star appearances during his impressive 18-year career. Fill out your starting five with the Level 30 Dark Matter Grant Hill card and utilize his versatility and athleticism on the perimeter or in the paint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/9d227c9e135d6d48bc6cd40c3d4b6c5c127ad2dc.jpg[/img]
Alston, Luka, Hill, and Williams are the makings of a formidable lineup, but it still needs a skilled power forward with a mastery of the fundamentals. Reach Level 40 and receive one of the greatest big men to ever suit up in the NBA, 100 OVR Tim Duncan. The “Big Fundamental” may have a calm and poised demeanor, but his play and resume were bold and authoritative during his 19 years in the league. With 15 All-Star selections, two MVPs, five NBA championships, and three Finals MVPs to his name, Duncan is a valuable reward for those who make it to the end of the Season rewards ladder.

Here are some other available rewards during Season 6:

● Level 18 Graffiti Basketball
● Level 32 Hall of Fame Badge Option Pack
● Level 37 Dark Matter Premium Player Door Game
● Level 38 Legend Badge

Legends are made in the playoffs; assemble a MyTEAM lineup composed of players who’ve stepped up on the biggest stage and delivered memorable moments over the years. Take advantage of all the featured rewards in Season 6 and put them to the test across all of MyTEAM’s competitive modes.

[h2][b]THE W ONLINE*[/b]
[/h2]
The next generation of WNBA stars are putting on a show ahead of the WNBA Draft on April 14. With the start of the 2025 WNBA regular season just a couple months away, we’ll soon see how the 2025 rookie class translates at the next level. Show your excitement for the future of the league by hitting the court in The W and competing for all-new rewards.

Take a look at some of the rewards below: 

Weekly Rewards

● Sheryl Swoopes Jersey Dress
● Taurus Top + Necklace
● Gemini Top + Necklace
● 8 Game Team Accelerator Boost
● Green Release Arm Sleeve
● Astronaut Helmet
● Anti Social Social Club Race Helmet
● 8 Game Team Resilience Boost

Season Rewards

● Golden State Valkyries Jersey Card
● Los Angeles Sparks Say Her Name Jersey
● Clothing Bundles
● Breakthrough Sleeve
● Badge Perks
● Dallas Wings Jersey Card
● Chicago Sky Say Her Name Jersey
● Candace Parker Coach Card
● Candace Parker Game Changer Jersey

Complete Weekly Goals to earn new Weekly Rewards, and compete and contribute to the Community Goal during Season 6 to unlock even more rewards and consumables.

[h2][b]SEASON 6 PRO PASS**[/b]
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/3e9628336b59140bae9b0da075379ba41e2536f2.jpg[/img]
Play like a seasoned pro with the Season 6 Pro Pass, and chase 40 additional tiers of [i]NBA 2K25[/i] rewards. Fuel your competitive hunger by incentivizing your game with even more MyCAREER rewards, powerful MyTEAM cards, and useful consumables to earn. Not only will you open the door to more content, but you’ll immediately receive some automatic rewards.

Season 6 Automatic Rewards:

● Dark Matter John Wall
● Season 6 Pro Pass Pack
● Sir C.C. - Cleveland Cavaliers Mascot
● Blue Digi One Leg Up Sweatpants

Put your game face on with Season 6 Pro Pass cosmetics, like the Level 6 Wrestler Facepaint, and pay homage to T-Mac with a throwback jersey for the ages. Show your team spirit on the court and around The City with all-new mascot skins and add to your MyPLAYER collection with even more earnable goodies.

Season 6 Earnable Rewards Include:

● Level 3 Tracy McGrady Toronto Raptors Jersey
● Level 6 Wrestler Facepaint

Every Season of [i]NBA 2K25[/i] comes included with a bevy of thematic rewards to flex your style, but you can get the most out of your experience with the Season Pro Pass. To learn more about the Pro Pass, you can visit the official [url=https://nba.2k.com/2k25/season-pass-faq/]FAQ page[/url].

[h2][b]2K BEATS[/b]
[/h2]
Take your game to the next level with the latest NBA 2K25 soundtrack update, featuring an exclusive playlist curated by TDE, the renowned American independent record label founded in 2004 by Anthony 'Top Dawg' Tiffith, and a new TDE apparel drop.

This playlist, packed with 13 electrifying tracks from a diverse lineup of talented artists, perfectly mirrors the excitement and intensity of the game. Players can listen exclusively to “Mop It Up” by Doechii only in NBA 2K25. From high-energy bangers to laid-back vibes, these songs will amp up your gameplay and enhance every moment on the court!

Want to share your thoughts on Season 5 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i]? Take our five-minute [i]NBA 2K[/i] Community Survey below and let us know what you’d like to see in the future! The survey will be available through April 7, 2025.

notes.title: Season 5 - NBA 2K25
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LW8anmzw_eQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Lock in for the end of the regular season during Season 5 of NBA 2K25.

Victor Wembanyama has officially touched down in Season 5 of NBA 2K25, bringing new anime-inspired player cards in MyTEAM, a host of MyCAREER rewards, and more content with him as the 2024-2025 NBA regular season comes to a close. Hone your craft in The City before the start of the NBA Playoffs to ensure you’re ready to perform in clutch time. As you compete and earn XP this Season, you’ll climb the Season rewards ladder and receive new cosmetics, consumables, MyTEAM cards, and more—let’s get started!

[h2]MyCAREER[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/3557e33d8ad60013afe826477b9f861fefa0539e.jpg[/img]

Chosen to carry the weight of the San Antonio Spurs on his shoulders, Wemby isn’t deterred by the high expectations, he rises above them with his towering 7-foot-3 frame. At 21 years old, the former No. 1 overall pick is determined to lead his team into the Playoffs and make some noise. Gain inspiration from Wemby and power your team to victory as MP in MyCAREER, and set your sights on clinching a coveted spot in the postseason.

As you motivate your teammates with superhuman performances, you’ll earn XP with each completed game and level up the Season rewards ladder. Season 5 boasts a bevy of exciting items that you can add to your MyPLAYER’s collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/1d1b6c8dc26fbb332c3cdebf835b12ee9a9efe25.jpg[/img]

Check out some of the rewards available during Season 5:
[list]
[*]Level 9 Skull Player Indicator
[*]Level 12 Black and White Maze Eyes
[*]Level 14 Personal Quadcopter
[*]Level 18 Jordan Unbannable MyCOURT Mural
[*]Level 20 ‘Burnie’ Miami Heat Mascot
[*]Level 21 REC Arm Sleeves with +15% REP 
[*]Level 23 Flame Colored Anime Spiky Hairstyle
[*]Level 32 ‘Keep On Going’ Teammate
[*]Level 36 Superhero Masquerade Mask
[*]Level 38 Quilted Cardigan Jacket
[*]Level 39 Superhero Outfit
[*]Level 40 +1 Cap Breaker
[/list]
Introduced in NBA 2K25 at launch, Badge Elevators are permanent boosts to an individual Badge, and can be used within 3 levels of its max potential (if you have a Bronze Badge it can be boosted to Silver, Gold, or Hall of Fame). For the first four Seasons, Badge Elevators have been available as Season Level rewards, but they’ve been capped at +2. Now, starting in Season 5, Badge Elevators are eligible for a +3 boost! From now through Season 8, you can use your Badge Elevators to climb three levels from Bronze to Hall of Fame. Take your game to the next level and improve your strengths, or fine tune some skills that need some polishing.

Turn up the intensity with all-new content in Season 5 and stay tuned for more information about upcoming events in The City and The Neighborhood by following NBA 2K across our social channels.

[h2]MyTEAM[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/e1ff945549bd3c01f2276c70e382ff59ee7b583b.jpg[/img]

Overshadow the competition with a MyTEAM lineup that features imposing length at every position. Season 5 of NBA 2K25 introduces a bevy of stunning hand-drawn, anime-inspired MyTEAM cards, including the face of this Season, Victor Wembanyama, beginning at Level 1 of the Season rewards ladder. Add to your card collection with the [b]Level 1 EVO Victor Wembanyama[/b] card (Amethyst to Diamond) and blot out any shots that enter your orbit. With this superhuman talent protecting the rim, your MyTEAM’s defense will be on another level, with the ability to swat shot attempts into the atmosphere.

Propel yourself up the rewards ladder by accruing XP and earn the [b]Level 10 Diamond Kelly Oubre Jr. [/b]card to strengthen the wing with a rangy, three-point specialist who can play impactful minutes when given the opportunity. Oubre can be inserted and excel in any lineup as an athletic forward who can snuff out guards on the perimeter or on the attack.

Long before Domantas Sabonis started commanding the paint and the glass for the Sacramento Kings, his father, Arvydas Sabonis, established himself as a physical playmaker in the NBA during the mid-to-late ‘90s. The former Portland Trail Blazer was an exceptional rebounder and creative passer, especially for his position and the era. Reach Level 33 and add [b]Galaxy Opal Arvydas Sabonis[/b] to your lineup, and pair his well-rounded skillset with Wemby and Oubre for a complementary 3-man lineup that boasts size, length, and three-point range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/7e9143e4277cbbdc4b1080d1b8e80f0b6dae711d.jpg[/img]

Complete the Season 5 rewards ladder with another former Portland Trail Blazer, three-time All-Star, and former Rookie of the Year, Brandon Roy. Despite a relatively short NBA career that spanned six seasons, Roy possessed superstar potential and was a potent offensive threat. Implement the [b]Level 40 Dark Matter Brandon Roy[/b] card into your lineup and wreak havoc with his freakish athleticism, gifted handles, and exceptional shot-making. Take the court with Wemby, Oubre, Sabonis, and Roy, and enjoy even more MyTEAM content as you progress through Season 5.

Below are more available rewards during Season 5:
[list]
[*]Level 18 Cyber Basketball
[*]Level 25 95+ Option Pack
[*]Level 37 97+ Galaxy Opal Door Game
[*]Level 38 Legend Badge
[/list]
[h2]Team Heroes Domination [/h2]

NBA All-Star Weekend is all about watching the best of the best go head-to-head in front of the world. While the 2025 All-Star Game is officially past, you can still challenge NBA superstars and legends during their prime in MyTEAM’s Domination mode.

During Season 5, NBA 2K25 will feature a Team Heroes Domination mode, where you can compete against the best player from all 33 teams during when they were at their peak. Defeat all 33 teams and earn 99 stars to receive a special Galaxy Opal Bob McAdoo card.

Season’s greetings, everyone! It’s the holiday season in The City and The Neighborhood, and we’ve got a sleigh full of festive rewards for you to earn during Season 3 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i], featuring 40 merry levels of Season content for you to unwrap by competing and earning XP.

With the NBA season well underway and the Emirates NBA Cup heating up, it’s the perfect time to appreciate the competitive, holiday spirit with some winter vibes in The City.

[h2]MyCAREER[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/a861c060bf766f4a02eedc8ac965aaece4155e44.jpg[/img]

Being ice cold typically isn’t a good thing in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], but for the next six weeks it is because it’s the most wonderful time of the year. Get in the holiday spirit this Season as you dunk, dish, and swish in a winter wonderland. Team up with friends or play solo as you skate to victory and hand your opponents an ‘L’, along with a lump of coal. Competing in MyCAREER and MyTEAM earns you XP, netting you jolly rewards—even if you’ve been naughty or nice. Climb the Season 3 rewards ladder and chase new decorative MyCOURT murals, throwback jerseys, and even more with the Season 3 Pro Pass*.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/a39c6cf66ab5e0becea589ebb66a3a254cb8fa4f.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the holidays and earn all-new thematic rewards as you dash through the defense and dip into your Santa-sized bag of crossovers to ice out the competition. Explore all The City and The Neighborhood have to offer during Season 3 and experience limited-time events while they last.

[h3]12 Days of Giving[/h3]

It’s officially a 2K Holiday Takeover in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]! Throughout the month of December, jingle all the way down candy cane lane and enjoy special winter and holiday-themed content in The City. Just like your presents, you’ll have to wait to see what's coming down the chimney; however, we are eager to share that the 12 Days of Giving event is returning in Season 3!

Starting on December 14, 2K25’s 12 Days of Giving celebration will feature a new surprise each day! Stay tuned to the official NBA 2K social handles for more.

[h2]MyTEAM[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/26bf090a22995c091144d12ac858faa11e012a71.jpg[/img]

One of the many keys to winning in the NBA is having a surplus of 3-and-D players, meaning it’s crucial to have guys who can play lockdown defense on the perimeter but also knock down three pointers at a high clip. For Season 3 of MyTEAM, we’re introducing a handful of cards that can provide similar two-way production for your squad.

Start the Season 3 rewards track with one of the most prolific 3-and-D players of all-time: Klay Thompson. The former Golden State Warrior and four-time NBA champion needs little to no introduction; this [b]Level 1 Klay Thompson Evo[/b] card has the potential to reach Amethyst and can add some sharpshooting versatility to your lineup.

Continue your ascent to the top of the Season 3 rewards mountain and reach Level 20 for a [b]Diamond Jae Crowder[/b] card. The 12-year NBA veteran has made a career out of guarding some of the league’s best players and shooting a respectable 34% from beyond the arc. Crowder is a solid depth piece on any 5v5 lineup or in Domination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/2f250460f79f608ce524df087c4cf80f25ab8a47.jpg[/img]

Round out your roster with a pair of former NBA champions and relentless rebounders from different eras: [b]Level 35 Pink Diamond Kevin Love[/b] and [b]Level 40 Galaxy Opal David Robinson[/b]. In his prime, the former dominated both ends of the floor with his length and physicality, and had the potential to drop 20 points and 20 rebounds on any given night. Robinson was a perennial MVP candidate—he won the award in 1995—during his 14 seasons with the San Antonio Spurs he averaged 21.1 points, 10.6 rebounds, and 3 blocks per game. With these towering bigs anchoring your lineup, you’ll have the potential to defend the paint and spread the floor.

The aforementioned players are just some of the heavy hitters available during Season 3 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i], with much more to earn to make your lineup even more potent. Take a look below.

Here are some other notable rewards available this Season:

[b][*]Level 10 Amethyst Gary Trent Jr.
[*]Level 13 Team Arena, Court Floor, Playbook, Logo, and Uniforms
[*]Level 25 Season 3 90+ OVR Player Option Pack
[*]Level 30 Season 3 92+ OVR Premium Player Option Pack
[*]Level 31 Diamond Shoe Variety Option Pack (Pick 3)[/b]

Experiment with various lineup combinations and access your collection from your mobile device with MyTEAM Mobile!

The NBA 2K25 MyTEAM experience is now on mobile! Access the MyTEAM Auction House on the go and elevate your game like never before.

Experience NBA 2K25’s iconic MyTEAM mode whenever, wherever with the NBA 2K25 MyTEAM Mobile app, available on iOS and Android. Collect your favorite NBA superstars and manage your lineup on the go, as you compete in various formats, including the all-new Showdown mode, where you can go head-to-head with a 13-card lineup, and single-player Breakout mode, featuring Triple Threat 3v3, Clutch Time 5v5, and shortened Full Lineup games.

Bridge the gap between console and mobile by syncing your device with your PlayStation or Xbox account, and start leveling up with cross-progression compatibility. Keep your head in the game and keep chasing the win to earn XP, MyTEAM REP, along with exciting rewards.

Chase victory during Season 2 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i]—the NBA season is here!

What’s up, NBA 2K Fans! Are you ready for the start of the 2024-2025 NBA season and Season 2 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i]? We’ve got a host of exciting details to share with you regarding Season 2, featuring Denver Nuggets star point guard and NBA champion Jamal Murray.

We’re a little over a month into [i]NBA 2K25[/i] and the competition around The City has been fierce—but the fun is only just beginning. For the next six weeks, you can look forward to out-of-this world content, a special look at Murray’s signature New Balance TWO WXY v5 shoe, all-new MyTEAM cards, and more! Prepare for Season 2 and NBA tip-off as we detail what's heading your way.

[h2]MyCAREER[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/5373b4aaad3b6ff84055e8dd94347eb0ae6224d2.jpg[/img]

Season 1 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i] was packed with a bevy of MyCAREER rewards, including Emotes, Green Releases, MyCOURT themes, and MyPLAYER cosmetics. Hopefully you were able to snag some of them and showcase your style as your MyCAREER legacy continues to unfold. 

For Season 2, we’re adding even more new content for you to earn so you can expand your collection of MyPLAYER rewards. Compete in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] to earn XP and level up to climb your way from Level 1 to Level 40 on the Season rewards ladder—and don’t forget, you can claim additional premium rewards with the Season Pro Pass*.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/d9148667fd7595460737e12dfb4f2a01eb447134.jpg[/img]

Take a look below at some of the rewards available during Season 2:
[list]

[*] Level 38 ‘Power’ Teammate
[*] Level 39 Mummy Costume
[*] Level 40 +1 Cap Breaker (New Gen)
[/list]

To learn more about Cap Breakers and their function, visit the official [url=https://nba.2k.com/2k25/courtside-report/myplayer-and-mycareer/]MyCAREER & MyPLAYER Courtside Report[/url].

[h2]2K x Jamal Murray: New Balance TWO WXY v5[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/3bf3d6f85fc5434de2d2ab7f2af79df0a2e50d12.jpg[/img]

Jamal Murray is a certified bucket; no matter the location or the occasion, he’s ready to lace up his New Balance TWO WXY v5s and hit the court. In collaboration with Murray for Season 2 of [i]NBA 2K25[/i], we’ve partnered with the Nuggets star to create a special, wearable version of his signature shoe in-game. Earn XP and level up to reach Level 32 to receive the New Balance TWO WXY v5.

Designed to capture Murray’s relentless attitude, his ability to make an impact whenever and wherever, and his love of NBA 2K, the TWO WXY v5 shoe features iridescent finishes and draws inspiration from various gem and diamond tiers from [i]NBA 2K25[/i].

Whether your MyPLAYER is a Shifty Shooter and Layup Mixmaster like Murray or an Inside-Out Scoring Threat power forward, the TWO WXY v5’s freedom-of-movement design is an excellent choice for any position.

[h2]MyTEAM[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/3f1fd5728e97d8bfb9792aa0fd1ab7c3fbeb18b9.jpg[/img]

Get your MyTEAM lineup locked in for the start of the 2024-2025 NBA season with a fresh batch of Season 2 reward cards. With the return of the Auction House, there’s more than one way to bolster your collection and supplement your MyTEAM lineup, but earning XP by competing is a tried-and-true method for securing all-new cards. Season 2 introduces high-flying players from the modern NBA, Hall of Fame wings with a knack for scoring, and a roster of sharpshooting guards headlined by Jamal Murray.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/b81afce2dac283456c1b94195f0092d8ccbf3eba.jpg[/img]

Start your ascent to Level 40 with the [b]Level 1 Sapphire Jamal Murray card[/b], which comes with an Evolution to an 89 Overall Ruby. Keep climbing the Season rewards ladder to Level 20 and receive an [b]Amethyst Obi Toppin[/b] card to give your MyTEAM some explosive athleticism. And for a Hall of Fame presence, reach Level 35 to claim a[b] Diamond James Worthy[/b] card. This Los Angeles Lakers legend is a force to be reckoned with on the offensive end of the floor, and can give your unit some size on the wing or in the paint.

The Indiana Pacers All-Star guard has quickly become one of the best players in the league because of his high IQ, red-hot three-point shooting, and exceptional playmaking gifts.

The WNBA Playoffs are coming down to the wire! Every basket, assist, steal, rebound, free throw, and foul has led to this moment: the WNBA Finals. While we wait for a champion to be crowned, you can chase your very own victory in The W, competing to earn XP for level-ups and all-new rewards. notes.title: Courtside Report: The City
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QAZSG32dQg0;full][/previewyoutube]

Welcome to [i]NBA 2K25[/i]’s vibrant environment, The City, where you can play anywhere and win everywhere. Here, you can interact with your surroundings and explore new opportunities as you live out your hoop dreams on PC. This year, we’ve designed the environment to feel more connected and accessible, with a competitive hub on the Boulevard of Stars, a larger-than-life arena to house Proving Grounds, the return of MyCOURT, and much more! Learn more about each of the key features and what else you can expect.

[h1]BOULEVARD OF THE STARS[/h1]

[i]NBA 2K25[/i] features an all-new living, breathing City with basketball at its core. Centrally located in the heart of The City is the Boulevard of the Stars, an upscale street with easy access to all of the game modes, shops featuring iconic global brands, and—returning in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]—your MyCOURT (more on that later). Everywhere you look in The City ties into basketball, even the light poles draw inspiration from perfect green releases; the surrounding buildings prominently display colorful murals featuring many of the league’s biggest stars, including cover athlete Jayson Tatum in front of your MyCOURT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/05aa48115ba5f6e59f31ce11767cf3f69547caa6.gif[/img]

The street is also lined with a Walk of Fame, which showcases every NBA championship team and leaves spots yet to be filled. Win championships of your own in MyCAREER to memorialize your dynasty alongside NBA history. 

Navigating this hoopers haven is a breeze, thanks to a more condensed map and intimate environment that was created with community feedback in mind, and designed to maximize accessibility. Nearly every building can be interacted with, eliminating empty spaces and making The City feel more dynamic.

[h1]PROVING GROUNDS[/h1]

Proving Grounds is the new home for heightened competition in The City. This colosseum-inspired arena is the go-to for ranked play to see how you stack up against everyone else in intense 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, or 5v5 games with comp-level difficulty sliders and Shot Meters turned off for everyone. Battle it out for bragging rights in this ultimate who's who destination, where you can also earn the best REP in the City!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/4c8f6fc115a6cb9850e987b95a466022acc161c6.jpg[/img]

There are five Proving Grounds tiers – [b]Bronze[/b], [b]Silver[/b], [b]Gold[/b], [b]Platinum[/b], and [b]Diamond[/b]. Play well and move up, but play poorly and you may drop a tier. The amount of progress you make is based on your level of play and the strength of your opponents, and matchmaking in Proving Grounds prioritizes pitting you against other players who are in a similar tier and team structure as you to ensure more balanced and competitive games.

Your tier is unique per game type per Season, but your best rank across all Seasons in each of the four game types is saved. Once you reach Silver, your tier will be displayed on your MyPLAYER gamerplate. Continue playing well to activate increasing REP multipliers and VC win bonuses at Gold, Platinum, and Diamond tiers for that game type. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/5075c86a579edde461f49807b73e42f263da0264.jpg[/img]

Leaderboards that update daily track the top-ranked players per game type and if you are in the Top 100 for any Proving Grounds game mode, your rank will also be shown off on your gamerplate. The top five ultimate competitors who hold [b]Top Ranked[/b] status will receive 2XREP in that game type and a Top Ranked Logo that displays their rank so long as they are in the Top 5, along with a special Animated Player Banner. In [i]NBA 2K25[/i], there are prizes for the Top 5 finishers in each game type and each Season this year.

Proving Grounds is the true place to compete in The City, and we can't wait to see the winning legacies you build.

[h1]PLAY ANYWHERE, WIN EVERYWHERE [/h1]

While Proving Grounds offers a more battle-tested environment, The REC, Theater, Pro-Am, Starting 5, and Ante-Up provide the same competitive fun without the risk of losing your ranking. Chase wins in any of these game modes to gain REP, XP, and earn rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/058500d4415b927ff8ffd5fe61f651c4b846078e.gif[/img]

Like many things in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], we’ve updated the look and feel of some of these locations—The REC, Pro-Am, and Ante-Up—with a fresh aesthetic. Ante-Up boasts a brand-new all-marble location to complement its risk-versus-reward format; Pro-Am boasts a new full-sized arena that can be unlocked once your team reaches Platinum tier; and last but not least, make a splash in The REC’s new environment with a multitude of enthusiastic fans celebrating your every move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/b4e26197418ae71f0490ed0980914e6e7a1051a5.jpg[/img]

[h1]MyCOURT[/h1]

MyCOURT is back! This apartment and basketball court combo at the center of The City is your private hub to practice and experiment on the court, and also a central location for [i]NBA 2K25[/i]'s basketball-focused MyCAREER.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/f7d1c39f7abe190236bcfcf9583bb59c08016835.gif[/img]

This is the best place to hone your skills and learn game mechanics between your adventures in The City. You can work on your shooting and dribbling in a freestyle environment on your own or with a ball machine, or invite friends and MyCAREER teammates to join you for various games, like 1v1, 3v3, HORSE, and more. In addition, MyCOURT now has new Difficulty Settings so that you can practice within the same sliders as your favorite game modes to fine-tune your game before you are ready to compete.

You can personalize your MyCOURT with new wall mural art earned through Quests and Season rewards, as well as game-worn jerseys you get from swapping jerseys with other NBA stars in the league. There is also easy access to the Learn 2K mode and the optional Heart of a Dynasty flashback MyCAREER story. Learn more in the MyCAREER Courtside Report.

[h1]RISE & ELITE AFFILIATIONS[/h1]

We are keeping the ELITE vs. RISE rivalry going this year and both affiliations will continue to battle it out in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] for the title of City champions each Season in brand new parks!

If you join ELITE, led by LD2K, you’ll be camped out in an old, dilapidated fort that was once home to a bustling pirate trade. The centerpiece of the park is an incredibly-detailed pirate ship that you can play both inside and on top of. You can even use a pulley system to travel from the ground to the top deck and a hop on a zipline to return to the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/984d4682ec6337255a1f06e1166debfff8776174.jpg[/img]

If you join RISE, led by ShakeDown, you’ll play in the heart of a bustling robot factory where 75-foot-tall mechs are being forged around you. You’ll see mech bodies being carried and transported overhead as they are constructed into their final form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/66e1ddaf3df378603c7d0be7d8aecc1270f53759.jpg[/img]

Based on community feedback, we designed the courts within each Affiliation park to be close together and easy to hop between to get you in the action faster.

[h1]WELCOME TO THE CITY[/h1]

In [i]NBA 2K25[/i], we are enhancing the experience for beginners with several new features designed to make The City more welcoming.

As you explore The City, you’ll be greeted by your Affiliation leads LD2K & ShakeDown at [b]HoloHelp info kiosks[/b] in front of every game mode building and activity. They will break down how each mode works and what skill level the experience is targeted for to familiarize you with all the different places and ways you can play. 

To help sharpen your skills, you can jump straight into the new [b]Learn 2K[/b] hub directly from your MyCOURT apartment. It’s packed with mini-games, drills, and practice scenarios, all tailored to help you master the basics and elevate your game to the next level.

As you start your competitive journey, we recommend visiting the RISE & ELITE Affiliation parks—each with two new novice-friendly [b]Casual Courts[/b] with easier difficulty. These 2v2 and 3v3 courts do not allow Squads and are restricted to the lowest Performance meter status, offering a more casual environment without the pressure of facing seasoned veterans. Here, you can learn how to play alongside others like you while still earning progress. Once you graduate to Hooper status, you won't be able to get next on these courts anymore and will be ready to move on to more challenging competition around The City.

We’ve also added a new Squad Finder feature that assists with finding your perfect team. You can select your preference of squad size, playstyle, microphone status, overall rating range, performance range, and affiliation to be connected with other like-minded players looking for a squad to run with. It’s a great way to establish new connections, build chemistry, and compete together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/fb211306be48bb8b37d793a09cc02a03c20efa53.jpg[/img]

Mastering NBA 2K takes lots of practice to hone your skills, but we hope these features improve accessibility and help you start strong on your path to becoming one of the best in The City.

[h1]STREETBALL[/h1]

Streetball was a community favorite in NBA 2K24 and our team wanted to go bigger and better with it this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/c9dd7f134701fa3b9187cff64018f3ede3049b1e.jpg[/img]

Streetball has been upgraded with more over-the-top rewards for your MyPLAYER to show off. There are three entirely new locations: on a building rooftop overlooking The City; on the beach surrounded by sand dunes; and inside The Temple.

New in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], we’re introducing an optional Co-Op mode for Streetball! You can join forces with up to 2 other friends in these 3v3 games to take down a new set of bosses and complete Streetball Quests together.

[h1]ICONIC NBA 2K15 MyPARKs[/h1]

We are excited to announce that [i]NBA 2K25[/i] will celebrate NBA 2K15 by bringing back all 4 MyPARKs as events in the Event Center!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/5310ab19f280c2601ac2463c6b2e76076f5a2996.gif[/img]

This includes the sun-drenched Sunset Beach park, the industrial Rivet City, the urban setting of the Old Town, and of course, the upgraded Old Town MyPARK on the aircraft carrier that the affiliation won by winning the MyPARK Championship back in 2K15.

These are all getting remasters down to the last detail while incorporating new gen tech and lighting. They look absolutely breathtaking and we can’t wait for our community to experience these all over again, or for the first time—it’s been over 10 years and a whole generation hasn’t had a chance to yet!

We’ll be unveiling a new remaster during each of the first four Seasons. The events will feature 2XP and 2XREP for the entire duration. We didn’t want these to be about sweating for prizes on leaderboards; this is all about having a tremendous time and revisiting these beloved MyPARKs with your friends.

The first event, coming at the end of Season 1, will take you back to the NBA 2K15 Old Town Flyers’ original MyPARK! Stay tuned for more info after [i]NBA 2K25[/i] launches.

[h1]REP & LEGEND[/h1]

We enjoyed watching the community’s dedication and REP grinds this past year, along with the intense competition that came with it.

In [i]NBA 2K25[/i], the year-long REP system is divided into four categories, each with five tiers: Rookie 1-5, Starter 1-5, Veteran 1-5, and Legend 1-5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/04335f6722ea8245315c070ed6db0720e19de6c4.jpg[/img]

At each tier, you’ll unlock rewards such as the new Cap Breakers, with 15 total available to earn as you advance through the REP tiers. These can not only increase your attribute ratings beyond their max potential ‘caps’, but also contribute toward meeting the attribute requirements needed to unlock new Animations, Badges, and Takeovers, and can even unlock special archetype names for your MyPLAYER.

Once you reach Legend 1, you become eligible for a spot on the Top 10 leaderboard. Top 10 status and the rewards that come with it are updated daily. But the journey doesn’t end there. There are additional rewards to be earned from Legend 2-5. For the truly devoted, a special reward awaits the first 100 players to reach Legend 4 on each platform.

At the end of the Boulevard of the Stars, we commemorate the first player to reach Legend each year from NBA 2K15 to NBA 2K24—some of the most dedicated players in NBA 2K history. We are excited to see who the first Legends will be in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]. 

[h1]AND SO MUCH MORE[/h1]

There's a ton going on in The City! Here are some more tidbits about what to expect in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]:
[list]
[*] Take a trip to the new [b]Triple Threat Park[/b] using the fast travel subway and revisit NBA 2K16’s iconic Rivet City Championship MyPARK, where you can play Triple Threat Online and Triple Threat Online: Co-Op multiplayer games using a lineup of NBA players. Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2878980/announcements/detail/6717768028451112080]MyTEAM Courtside Report[/url] to learn more.
[*] We are debuting a new shop called [b]Limited Edition[/b], where clothing drops from an ever-revolving list of fashion brands will be available first.
[*] [b]Gatorade Gym[/b] is now an open-area workout platform on the beach. Nearby, there are two Gatorade courts where Gatorade Boosts that temporarily increase your physical attributes are activated for the duration of games played there. Further along the beach, there are also two courts that give a 25% REP bonus.
[*] We’re also improving the way [b]Rebirth[/b] works in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]. Now, anytime you use Rebirth to create a new build, you instantly unlock the maximum potential of your new MyPLAYERs to the highest overall rating you’ve previously reached. On top of that, your Silver-level Badges will still be automatically unlocked once attribute requirements are met, and you’ll receive a Badge level progression accelerator. The MyCAREER Quest to unlock Rebirth becomes available once you have reached 90 OVR on a save.
[*] [b]The Track[/b] is a new indoor karting warehouse that features elaborate tracks and bike and go-kart driving mechanics, developed by the team behind the vehicle physics in LEGO 2K Drive. As you race, you'll see ghosts of the target time, your best time, and the #1 player on the leaderboard’s best time racing alongside you. Each week, 1 Million VC will be awarded to the first-place finisher. This is a great time whenever you need a change of pace and we encourage everyone to try it out. Be on the lookout for new races released every week!
[*] Earn new [b]Teammote[/b] dances that you and your squad perform in perfect sync with music. Use Teammotes to show off your moves during pre-game intros, around The City, during matchmaking screens, and more.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/c7b88e8f2d7a3929114e4efa229c59333abc588c.gif[/img]

[b]CLOSING REMARKS[/b]

This year, we’ve focused our efforts on giving the community what it wants in The City, and we’re grateful for all of the tremendous support and feedback. We’re proud of what we’ve created this year and we can’t wait for you to experience all of the City’s new features, from Proving Grounds to 2K15 Events, and beyond. If you haven’t already, be sure to check out our other Courtside Reports to learn more about the updates to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2878980/announcements/detail/4337614262850909036]Gameplay[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2878980/announcements/detail/4337614897902569332]MyCAREER[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2878980/announcements/detail/4337614897921216044]MyNBA[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2878980/announcements/detail/4252047138008426812]The W[/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2878980/announcements/detail/6717768028451112080]MyTEAM[/url]!

notes.title: Courtside Report: MyTEAM
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=IPA1lbERbHI;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]NBA 2K25[/i] challenges you to prove you’re the best of the best in the popular card-collecting mode, MyTEAM. [i]NBA 2K25[/i] adds four new game modes, a new year-long MyTEAM REP system with perks and rewards throughout the mode, dozens of quality of life updates, and the return of a major feature. MyTEAM in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] is the ultimate combination of new experiences and fan feedback. This year, there’s truly something for everyone, with intuitive functions to make getting in the game streamlined and easy.

[h1]THE AUCTION HOUSE IS BACK[/h1]

The Auction House returns in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] MyTEAM where you can auction off or acquire cards using MyTEAM Points (MTP) to enhance your Collection! New in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], the Auction House menu has been consolidated into a one-stop shop for searching, buying, and selling – no more exiting back to the MyTEAM menus to retrieve your completed Auctions or check on your Bids. You can also search for a selected card directly from your My Auctions menu, so you can easily check MTP prices before listing your card for sale. Need more space in your My Auctions menu? Earning more MyTEAM REP will increase your My Auctions capacity allowing you to get the most out of the Auction House.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/3df0515eba4dde7022056d17e4e4ef07411590a6.gif[/img]

To ensure a level playing field, the returning Auction House has a zero-tolerance policy on activity detrimental to the health of the mode. All transactions will go through a verification process to make sure the Auction House stays fun and fair for everyone in the community. The love for the MyTEAM Auction House is clear and we are excited for its return!

[h1]TRIPLE THREAT PARK[/h1]

Only available on New Gen, [i]NBA 2K25[/i] introduces one of the biggest upgrades to MyTEAM in its history—Triple Threat Park! Meet new friends face-to-face to team-up with or play against in the new home for Triple Threat Online and Triple Threat Online: Co-Op multiplayer games. Triple Threat Park will be accessible on PC from within the MyTEAM menus or from The City. For the first time, you will take the court in Park gameplay with NBA Players while your MyPLAYERs cheer from the sidelines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/478c330ee62987e0007a1ec82d05208d1d567251.gif[/img]

Triple Threat Park is a faithful remaster of [i]NBA 2K16[/i]'s Rivet City Championship MyPARK, including details down to the iconic chain nets and glass walkways—this is one of the most iconic MyPARKs in [i]NBA 2K[/i] history! Like the original Rivet City rooftop, there are a total of nine courts. Four of these courts are for 2-player 3v3 games where each person controls a 3 Player Card lineup. The other five courts are for 6-player 3v3 Co-Op games where each person controls 1 Player Card, with two of these courts designated as “No Squad” courts.

You can earn rewards in Triple Threat Park every day just by getting a win or going on win streaks, with even more rewards available from Challenges and Limited Time Events!

[h3]Exploring Triple Threat Park[/h3]

Show off your MyTEAM REP progress, your ranking from the last King of the Court event, your current Showdown tier, as well as your first choice Player Card on your customized Player Panel as you walk around Triple Threat Park as your MyPLAYER.

Once you approach a court's open Got Next spot, your MyPLAYER will walk onto the court and present your MyTEAM cards, which then reveal the NBA players you will be controlling.

Express your style with your MyPLAYER across both MyCAREER & MyTEAM as apparel and customizations earned through Season rewards now benefit Triple Threat Park as well. There is also a pop-up shop within Triple Threat Park where you can upgrade your swag and pick up new MyTEAM cards from the Pack Market.

[h3]Showcase Spot[/h3]

A special feature in Triple Threat Park is the Showcase Spot. If you step onto the Showcase Spot, you will open packs on a massive billboard for everyone to see. If you obtain a high-powered Player Card, that player will make a grand entrance complete with a fireworks display, visible to the entire Triple Threat Park.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/17c7193cdf4cd5621522a449e61e99a21bf31567.gif[/img]

As an added bonus, the first time you use the Showcase Spot each day you’ll unlock 30 minutes of 2XREP for MyTEAM REP!

When you open packs through the pop-up shop or the MyTEAM store, the cards you obtain may be displayed live above your MyPLAYER. You can also show off your earned Player Cards by accessing your Unopened Packs menu from anywhere in Triple Threat Park. Once you open an award pack with a high level Player Card, the card art will appear over your MyPLAYER's head!

[h1]BREAKOUT[/h1]

Breakout is a new mode that houses the revamped single player experience in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] MyTEAM. After selecting a starting difficulty, you will begin in the middle of Breakout City, surrounded by various arenas representing game modes, eras, and opponents that you choose to compete against. 

Your goal is to break out of the game board and earn your reward! Choose your direction to move and compete in a quick Triple Threat 3v3, Clutch Time 5v5, or a shortened 13-card Full Lineup game. Before starting a game, you can preview the game types and opponents. Discover the rewards available on the outer rim of the game board by unlocking the neighboring spot.

As you explore each board, you'll play against a range of opponents, including current NBA teams, historic teams in Era-themed games in the 1980s / 1990s / 2000s / 2010s, All-Time teams, and theme teams of new collections released throughout the year.

Wins earn Prize Points and progress in that direction on the board. In addition, each game has single-game Objectives to earn extra Prize Points. These Prize Points are needed to unlock the reward spaces on the board, and the spaces with the best rewards require more Prize Points before you can play those games. Choose your opponents and games wisely, because if you lose 3 times in a run you will need to start over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/38a93ee5e845336ed86abfe9b5edd083fd90d841.jpg[/img]

As you move farther away from the center spot, the difficulty level goes up. Higher difficulties give more Objectives, which can shorten the number of games between you and your reward. Once you reach the outer edge, you will face off against a final gatekeeper team. These gatekeepers are the final run-ending opponents that stand between you and the reward you selected.

With the addition of Breakout, the standalone Triple Threat and Clutch Time modes have been retired and merged into this brand new, comprehensive experience. However, within Breakout, you can choose to play on boards that exclusively contain Triple Threat or Clutch Time games. Both Triple Threat and Clutch Time games are now played in the ‘House of Clutch’ arena, with Triple Threat games still using a smaller 3v3 court, but with fans behind the court-surrounding barriers and away from the action.

[h1]SHOWDOWN[/h1]

Showdown is a new head-to-head multiplayer mode in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] that draws inspiration from the competitive modes of previous MyTEAM years and will be replacing Unlimited.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/729250f6e003f3288cd9a179862692155485a300.jpg[/img]

Games are played with 13-card Full Lineups and 4-minute quarters. The core of this mode is a progression system across 15 tiers, where the primary goal is to win and get promoted. You will start at Tier 15 and work your way up to Tier 1 as you stack up wins. As an extra incentive, if you go on a win streak you will earn extra progression up the ladder. Losses will count against you, but there are checkpoints built into each Tier to protect your progress. Once you are promoted to a higher Tier, you cannot drop down a Tier during a Season.

Every Friday at 8 AM Pacific Time, if you have gotten a few wins in the last week, you will be able to choose a reward group based on the tier you are currently in. Getting even more wins each week will upgrade these reward selections. There are also rewards that are refreshed each Season that can be earned immediately as you reach those milestones. At the end of each 6-week Season, you will drop a number of tiers based on where you ended the Season, offering a fresh challenge the next Season without starting from scratch.

Showdown features an improved leaderboard that only considers games played between Tier 1 players. This will ensure the leaderboard accurately represents the best players in Showdown. Tiers also come into play for matchmaking, which will prioritize matching you up with opponents at a similar tier as you.

After you get a target amount of Showdown wins each week, you will qualify for our new competitive mode, King of the Court.

[h1]KING OF THE COURT[/h1]

King of the Court is an exclusive event held every Saturday from 10 AM to 2 PM Pacific Time, starting on September 14. To qualify, you must meet certain qualification thresholds in either the new Showdown or Triple Threat Park modes during the preceding week, or earn automatic qualification by rising up the MyTEAM REP tiers.

After each King of the Court game, you will earn a Game Score based on your performance. If you lose 3 games, your time in that Saturday's King of the Court will be over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/b264893a7e617c3273f9fd2d558c08cc3394b1e7.jpg[/img]

Your final Game Score each Saturday will be ranked amongst all competitors in groups representing the Top 50%, Top 10%, Top 1%, and the ultimate #1 King of the Court. The group you finish in determines which tiers of rewards you receive. These rewards are some of the best available in MyTEAM and are refreshed weekly, including packs, MyTEAM-exclusive Indicator and Perfect Release Cards, and more including 1 Million VC for the King of the Court! Your accomplishments in the most recent King of the Court will also be proudly displayed on your MyPLAYER Player Panel while in Triple Threat Park.

This is where the best of the best in MyTEAM will compete!

[h1]CHALLENGES[/h1]

[i]NBA 2K25[/i]’s MyTEAM combines Agendas and Challenges together into the new Challenges menu. This is your single stop for most of the live content updates that MyTEAM receives multiple times each week. Starting from the HOME tab, you will see three selected Challenges with rewards and your progress. At any given time, these will feature quick Challenges that can be completed in a single game, ones that may take a few games to complete, and Challenge Groups with greater rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/2676bc48e72c799568780880b85a67d4a4e426bf.jpg[/img]

It has never been easier to quickly get into a game in MyTEAM, as every mode can now use an Autofill lineup which automatically generates a lineup based on your collection. Typically these will use your best Player Cards available, but if a Challenge requires completing a specific stat like making threes or getting rebounds, this Autofill will adjust to ensure you have the best lineup for that Challenge.

These Challenges can link you directly to any valid MyTEAM mode to try and complete them in, or, you can select from a quick Pick-Up Triple Threat, Clutch Time, or Full Lineup game. Great if you just want to jump into a game and grind out a single Challenge without affecting your mode progress.

[h1]MyTEAM REP[/h1]

[i]NBA 2K25[/i] introduces a REP system to MyTEAM. REP serves as a year-long measure of success and does not reset like the 40 Levels in each Season.

There are 11 levels of MyTEAM REP Rewards, represented by the familiar MyTEAM Gem Colors, Bronze through Dark Matter. The MyTEAM REP menu also features a leaderboard of the Top Ten REP Players, designated with Invincible Logos, with No. 1 overall receiving the G.O.A.T. Logo. These REP Logos, regardless if you are in the Top Ten or making progress at your own pace, will appear beside you throughout MyTEAM.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/b60b6eacb23a22db1c8b7458041296460e0ff0e1.jpg[/img]

You'll earn REP by completing games and Challenges, and there will be 2XREP events to give you a boost. You'll feel the progression of your team as you rise up the ranks in your MyTEAM journey this year. Each time you REP up, you will unlock new rewards, including access to the Auction House, expanded My Auctions capacity to hold more cards, returning rewards like the Fire Ball and MyTEAM Coliseum, regularly released free packs in the Pack Market, and an exclusive G.O.A.T. Jayson Tatum Player Card by reaching the Dark Matter tier! You can even earn automatic access to weekend King of the Court events without needing to qualify each week.

At the end of July, those who are ranked in the MyTEAM REP Top 10 as Invincible or G.O.A.T. level players will receive the ultimate rewards, related to [i]NBA 2K26[/i]'s MyTEAM mode. We will share more information on this later in the year!

[h1]GETTING STARTED[/h1]

When you first enter MyTEAM, you’ll see a brand new tutorial designed to teach you not only the basics of MyTEAM but, if you need it, also the basics of basketball and [i]NBA 2K[/i] gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/2b593808dd1eba7be2206c56293adc63d3183881.jpg[/img]

First, you'll open your Starter Kit containing cards from your favorite NBA team and customize your team's name and city. You’ll get two Option Packs filled with All-NBA caliber Free Agent player cards included with each Starter Kit, no matter which team you select. Choose two Diamond-level Free Agent Current Players which will remain with your team for an extended 25 games. Then, choose an All-Time NBA legend Free Agent player, rated as a Pink Diamond, which will play 10 games with your MyTEAM before it expires.

You will then be asked what your experience with [i]NBA 2K[/i] MyTEAM is. If you’re new to [i]NBA 2K[/i] and playing on New Gen, you’ll be taken to the new Learn 2K tutorial to get started. If you’re familiar with [i]NBA 2K[/i] but new to MyTEAM, you'll be guided through an introduction of the various MyTEAM modes, features, and lineup management, followed by Welcome to MyTEAM challenges. Maybe you already know what you're doing—you can choose to skip these introductions and get right into the action.

Even if you are an experienced MyTEAM player, there are some exclusive rewards including both Free Agent and Reward Player Cards to get you started, including the historic Trail Blazer pairing of Damian Lillard and LaMarcus Aldridge which have a Dynamic Duo boost. Completing this mode tour will also reward you with an Option Pack where you can pick one of five Evolution players that can upgrade from Emerald, to Sapphire, to Ruby. All of these challenges will be available for you to complete on your own, if you decide to skip the tutorial.

[h1]NEW MENUS AND UI[/h1]

All of these changes and improvements in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] MyTEAM bring along new, streamlined menus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/5c3d998a69278cbd26eecb1b72d3f95ee45ba1bc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Courtside Report: The W
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=X-QZem5VRBA;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you ready to lead the next generation of WNBA players in The W? Go head-to-head with many of the game’s rising stars, as you chase the ultimate goal of becoming a legend in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]. This year, experience The W unlike ever before and enjoy all-new features on your journey to GOAT status!

[h1]BECOME THE GOAT[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/4afef9b4de907c0fb084149d18780c7c915d5d8e.gif[/img]

Climb the all-time ranks in the Pursuit of Greatness story, where you’ll strive to become the greatest player of all time. Build a career that eclipses the best players in WNBA history and create career-defining moments throughout your journey. First up on your Pursuit of Greatness journey is to outshine your fellow rookies. You'll be dropped right into the captivating 2024 WNBA Rookie of the Year race, which is the overarching narrative of your first season, competing against players like Caitlin Clark, Angel Reese, and Kamilla Cardoso.

As you bolster your resume with on-court accomplishments like championships and awards, your progress will be visualized on detailed graphs that illustrate where you are in your career, and how you stack up against the next player on the GOAT list that you’re chasing. From Cynthia Cooper’s four rings and four Finals MVPs, to Alyssa Thomas’ ongoing triple-double record, surpass these WNBA legends and push the boundaries of greatness.

[h1]PRESS CONFERENCES[/h1]

In your Pursuit of Greatness, you'll have the opportunity to participate in press conferences—a first for The W. These fully-voiced and interactive interviews, written by WNBA journalist Lyndsey D'Arcangelo, give you a deeper connection to your MyPLAYER and provide options to shape the narrative of not only your career, but also the league as a whole. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/b0b8ce28914876c14e29ac36a244c80fa2156b03.jpg[/img]

At the start of your journey, you'll have an introductory press conference to broadcast your WNBA ambitions. From there, press conferences will happen after key moments and games, such as breaking a record, winning an award like Rookie of the Year, or crossing a career milestone. When you compete against someone on the GOAT list, like [i]NBA 2K25[/i] cover athlete A'ja Wilson, the questions you’re asked could vary depending on your performance, be it good or bad.

Experience the life of a real WNBA athlete and choose how you want to be viewed in the eyes of the public.

[h1]THE W ONLINE*[/h1]

The W Online has moved to a stunning new outdoor court in a forest grove, where you can play 3v3 multiplayer games amidst a gorgeous backdrop of redwood trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/956cea44f114820f43f9e1313bf51195fc90c302.gif[/img]

Weekly Community Goals are back in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] and require a collective effort from all players to accomplish them. These goals now track new stats, like the number of excellent green shot releases and your teammate grades. If the community hits the goal in at least four out of the six weeks of each Season, everyone receives a reward, with the rarity of the reward you receive being determined by how much you contributed.

[h3]Game Changers Mentorship[/h3]

[i]NBA 2K25[/i] builds on the Game Changer status—earned by contributing to the weekly Community Goals—with a new feature called Mentorship. On top of special rewards like Player Boosts for you or your teammates, every couple of games you will have the chance to take another player, who is not yet a Game Changer, under your wing as your mentee. They will receive a challenge, such as “You have been challenged to grab 7 rebounds, and here’s +1 to your Rebounding attribute to help you out.” If you can guide your mentee to complete their challenge, you will also receive a boost to your Community Goal contributions. Everyone wins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/b77c7553b02c332586b937c62d12e320b80a975b.png[/img]

The number of successful Game Changers Mentorships you complete will be tracked and displayed on your Player Panel, showcasing your valuable contributions to the community and inspiring others to engage in some mentoring of their own.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]

Throughout the year, new rewards will be available for your MyPLAYER in The W Online, earned by completing shorter stat goals that refresh every week. Completing these will contribute towards the overall weekly Community Goal and also unlock exciting rewards, including brand new jersey dresses, featuring WNBA players on the GOAT list, holiday-themed clothes, and much more. Game Changers can also earn exclusive rewards like arm sleeves, ball trails, and green release animations. This is just a preview of what's to come in each [i]NBA 2K25[/i] Season!

The W allows you to live out your WNBA dreams like never before in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]. Be sure to check out the Gameplay and ProPLAY Courtside Report to learn more about how you can dominate the game, and stay tuned for more news and information in the future.

[i]*Online play requires an Internet connection and NBA 2K Account. Terms apply.[/i]
