notes.title: Courtside Report: MyNBA & MyGM
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=r45j95USUfk;full][/previewyoutube]

Calling all armchair General Managers and keyboard coaches, build the next great dynasty on PC in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]. Test your ability to juggle the lofty expectations of an NBA fanbase and team leadership, while assembling a championship roster available on PC. This year, we’re giving you the power to create your own backstory and control the narrative surrounding your success.

[h1]MyGM[/h1]

MyGM returns in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]! This RPG franchise mode puts you in the role of an NBA team's General Manager. You’ll navigate roster building, managing your Governor's and team's expectations of you, and much more as you run a world-class, championship NBA franchise.

[h3]Pick a Backstory[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/0d726db8f9103dae6ff03a2985a760e459a7ff4c.gif[/img]

We have redesigned MyGM to be even more of a role-playing experience this year. When you start, you will select a backstory: Are you an Ex-Player transitioning to the front office, an Ex-Scout experienced in identifying talent, a Savant with financial savvy, a Capitalist focused on making a splash with your deep connections, or a Closer knowledgeable in the art of the deal? You can choose from these options or create your own backstory!

Your backstory determines your initial attributes, which in turn determine your baseline boosts and leads to different playstyles for running your franchise as you navigate through conversations. For example, having many points committed to Offense would enhance your team’s scoring prowess; while having many points dedicated to Charisma would open up new conversation options to lead to a more diverse set of goals to target, and some routes that can provide more XP.

Here are all the attributes that make up your GM:
[list]
[*] Offensive Coaching - Improves the team's offensive attributes; unlocks conversation options.
[*] Defensive Coaching - Improves the team's defensive attributes; unlocks conversation options.
[*] Sports Medicine - Improves the team's training and reduces the impact of fatigue and injuries; unlocks conversation options.
[*] Business - Improves team attendance; unlocks conversation options.
[*] Charisma - Affects trades, contract negotiations, and team morale; unlocks numerous conversation options.
[*] Analytics - Improves scouting; unlocks conversation options.
[/list]
[h3]Perks[/h3]

As you complete Goals, you will earn XP and level up to unlock more attribute points and new Perks. While attributes offer broad benefits and affect conversation choices, Perks are unique abilities that offer a dramatic boost to specific areas of your GM skills, both on and off the court.

Each backstory starts off with a unique Perk already equipped. Most levels will give you an additional attribute point; however at Levels 4, 8, 12 and 16 you’ll receive an additional Perk and once you hit the level cap of 20 you’ll get two additional Perks. Level 12 is another important level, as every backstory will be able to pick their exclusive, ultimate Perk. For example, if you are an Ex-Player, you start off with the Former Player Perk. You can read the locker room and are able to relate to your players, so this gives you a Team Chemistry boost all the time and generally helps ensure that your team will be playing its best. At Level 12, you will be able to select the Lionheart Perk, which ensures your players start warm and your star player starts hot when facing elimination in the Playoffs, bringing them closer to achieving Takeover.

[i]NBA 2K25[/i] is loaded with Perks, with 55 available to choose from at launch, and more set to be unveiled throughout the year. When you begin your character creation, you’ll be prompted to pick one to two Perks and then earn more as you level up. Take a look at the full list of Perks below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/7b7a44ff564255f4c59c161c6277bf16ada43bff.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/9e15b2abf806d2365bf46843abb44f1fc017b534.jpg[/img]

[h3]Goals & Conversations[/h3]

A core part of MyGM is conversations with your staff and players, as you manage everyone's needs and the Goals they set for you. We are focusing on a smaller number of impactful conversations for a better experience, rather than overwhelming you with constant chit-chat requests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/d9739adbd3574ea8c6bc6b524cee7b82e6424c13.jpg[/img]

Your backstory and attribute ratings can come into play during these conversations and unlock more paths by determining the dialogue choices you have available to respond in a way that best satisfies your goals. Perhaps your team's Governor wants to give you a Goal to win a championship this year. As you progress through the conversation, you’ll come to several choices on how to direct the conversation. You can be a ‘yes man’ and agree to the monumental task, or decline and risk the Governor’s wrath. But if your Charisma is high enough, you can go down a route where you set up easier goals, such as only making the conference finals. The routes unlocked by your attributes aren’t always the best option based on your situation, but the harder the objective the more experience you’ll receive. It's in your hands to determine what your Goals are and use your unique style and strategy in conversations to shape your MyGM story.

[h3]MyGM Building[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/c678f923dcf0f1ccf825f5842d7c5e8a2f23dca3.jpg[/img]

Brand new in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] on PC is the MyGM Building, a free-roaming space where you take control of your MyGM to carry out responsibilities as the brains of the team.

When the Governor or one of your staff members wants to have a conversation with you, you'll see a notification on the calendar or other landing menus. Maybe the CFO needs to talk to you about cutting costs or managing public opinion, or the Head Coach wants to talk to you about a lineup change. You can then go into the MyGM Building and walk up to them to have a conversation in-person for a more authentic experience.

[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]

The ‘Ranked’ mode from the previous MyNBA is now tied to MyGM; compete with others to see how quickly you can hit Level 20.

If you get fired by your Governor, it's Game Over! With so many options and ways to play, we’re sure you’ll have a ton of fun trying new MyGM builds as you do your best to make your way up the leaderboards.

[h1]THE CURRY ERA[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/781cbb6c7a20500fd79f409be6797708dfeb9f7c.gif[/img]

Eras in MyNBA take you back in time to start your league during the greatest periods of NBA history. The Magic vs. Bird Era, Jordan Era, Kobe Era, and LeBron Era all return on New Gen in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], along with the new Steph Era!

The Steph Era begins during the 2016-17 NBA season, and you can relive the legendary Golden State Warriors with Steph Curry, Kevin Durant, Klay Thompson, and Draymond Green, or try to stop their legacy as they dominate the league.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/89bd6cf33788295866384d94524c27dcc376d4db.jpg[/img]

While the Warriors and Cleveland Cavaliers, led by LeBron James and Kyrie Irving, were the heavyweight matchup year after year during this time period, this is a historic era for many reasons. 

Former teammates James Harden and Russell Westbrook were thriving as solo artists, delivering MVP-caliber performances on a near-nightly basis. Harden powered the Houston Rockets record-breaking offense and Westbrook joined Oscar Robertson as the only players to average a triple-double over the span of an entire season. Out in the East, Giannis Antetokounmpo started emerging as a superstar on the Milwaukee Bucks and the Boston Celtics were busy piecing together their pair of future NBA Champions in Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown.

The Steph Era boasts some of the greatest NBA superstars at their peak, with budding talents making a name for themselves.

[h1]MORE MyNBA IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

MyGM includes a bevy of new and exciting features, but we made sure to give MyNBA some love also. From the NBA Cup to streamlined MySTAFF management, and more, take a look at some of the key updates. 

[h3]NBA Cup[/h3]

The NBA Cup, which debuted as the In-Season Tournament in the 2023-24 NBA season, now has more in-depth integration into MyNBA modes.

This tournament consists of a group play stage followed by single-elimination knockout rounds and, on PC in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], the NBA Cup now supports between 12 and 36 teams with dynamic groups that change from year to year as you simulate your future of the league.

[h3]League Expansion & Contraction[/h3]

In New Gen on [i]NBA 2K25[/i] MyNBA introduces full fluidity to add or remove up to 6 teams to the league each and every offseason, rather than being limited to a total of 6 teams per save. Whether you want to accurately recreate the league's expansion boom in the 80s and 90s or dramatically increase (or decrease) the size of the league in the Modern Era, this unlocks more possibilities to customize your MyNBA.

[h3]League News in Eras[/h3]

When you start from a historical Era, the way League News is delivered to you changes over time to authentically represent what it was like in each Era. Previously, this started as the 2K Times newspaper, evolved into a web 1.0 page, and finally became a social media feed.

In [i]NBA 2K25[/i], we have added a new web 2.0 page format to bridge the gap in the late 2000s, between the start of the internet and modern-day social media. This web 2.0 page is designed to be reminiscent of how [i]NBA 2K[/i] game menus looked in [i]NBA 2K11[/i]!

[h3]Streamlined MySTAFF Management[/h3]

Previously, MySTAFF had up to 17 staff positions surrounding your GM for you to fill and manage, but we noticed this could be overwhelming for players.

This year, MySTAFF management is simplified to your Governor, GM, Assistant GM, Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the Head Coach, Head Scout and Team Doctor.

Instead of managing all the staff within these departments, you can now hire Bonus Staff under each department as you need. Bonus Staff are an easy way to boost the performance of a department without having to micromanage hiring and firing the extra staff. Want to make a big push in the playoffs? Move the bonus staff to the Head Coach. Trying to cash in on a ton of draft picks? Move the bonus staff to the Head Scout. You’ll have the flexibility to balance what you want out of the team, as well as any other tasks you might have if playing in MyGM.

[h1]CLOSING REMARKS[/h1]

Now that you’ve learned all about the updates to MyNBA and MyGM, it’s time to put them to practice. Assume the role of a General Manager in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] and prove you have the knowledge and the skills to create the next NBA dynasty. Whether you decide to add to the storied history of a franchise or do something that’s never been done before, we can’t wait to see you succeed.

If you haven’t already, be sure to check out our other Courtside Reports, with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2878980/announcements/detail/4337614262850909036]detailed breakdowns of ProPLAY™[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2878980/announcements/detail/4337614897902569332]the customization options available for MyPLAYERS in MyCAREER[/url].

notes.title: Courtside Report: MyPLAYER, MyCAREER, Badges & Takeover
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ifs6oppE858;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]NBA 2K25[/i] is just around the corner and we’ve got plenty to discuss ahead of its launch, including the MyPLAYER Builder, an all-new Takeover system, improved Badge progression, and the immersive MyCAREER mode. For the latest iteration of the franchise, we were adamant about making significant changes to each of the aforementioned areas for a more tailored experience. Whether you’re new to [i]NBA 2K[/i], a returning player, or a savvy veteran, there’s more than one way to play. Let’s get started!

[h1]MyPLAYER BUILDER[/h1]

Every MyCAREER starts with building your MyPLAYER, which is possibly the most integral moment on your journey to creating a legacy for yourself. We understand the importance of this process, so we’ve spent a good deal of time ensuring you have the tools necessary to build just the right player for you.

[i]NBA 2K25[/i]’s MyPLAYER Builder offers an array of customizations in the structure and archetype of your MyPLAYER, with over a hundred new possible archetypes you can create. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/07666ece931d78c701e3d549ae7cba045524a24a.jpg[/img]

When you enter the MyPLAYER Builder, you’ll have the option to choose from:

[h3]1. Create-Your-Own Build[/h3]
Whether you’re a build-making veteran who has mastered the MyPLAYER Builder, or just looking to experiment and create a unique build, anyone can use the world-class MyPLAYER Builder to create a build from scratch. You can choose your position and measurements, and meticulously adjust your individual Attribute Potential, all while seeing how these choices will affect the various benefits you can eventually be equipped with.

[h3]2. Community Build[/h3]
First introduced in [i]NBA 2K24[/i], Community Builds spotlight creations from standout players in the community that you can use as a blueprint to build your MyPLAYER to compete at the highest levels. We saw 35 awesome templates last year from some of your favorite build makers, and this year we’ll be adding brand-new builds from new and returning build makers. The first Community Builds will be available in Season 2, with more becoming available each Season.

Through each of these MyPLAYER Builder paths, you’ll have access to more information than ever before. If you want to nerd out and dig deeper, you can preview all of the benefits you qualify for, including Badges, Takeovers in the New Takeover System, and Signature Animations.

Once you have a MyPLAYER Build you like, we suggest taking it for spin in the Build Tester. First, you’ll be presented with the Equip screen, where you can see all the Signature Animations your build has the potential to unlock, and other customization options like jump shots and dunk packages. Participate in 3v3 or 5v5 games, or play the new Freestyle practice option to experiment without teammates or opponents to hone your skills. We hope these improvements provide a better experience for New Gen players in The City.

This year’s MyPLAYER Builder is designed to cater to different playstyles and strategic preferences. Whether you’re creating your MyPLAYER from scratch or leveraging community wisdom, each option in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] is crafted to fit your style.

[h3]Attribute Refresh[/h3]

In [i]NBA 2K25[/i], we refreshed a handful of physical attributes, as well as how you earn Stamina. 

There are now five Physical attributes in the MyPLAYER Builder: Speed With Ball (in the Playmaking category), Speed, Agility, Strength, and Vertical.

Stamina is now earned through Gatorade Gym workouts. Each MyPLAYER starts off with an 85 Stamina attribute rating. Doing a workout adds 2 Stamina attribute points, regardless of your workout result, and you can do 4 workouts each week. Once any of your MyPLAYERs reaches a 99 Stamina attribute rating, it is permanent. As an added bonus for hitting the gym, if you get at least 3 stars on all 4 weekly workouts, you will receive a temporary Turbo Meter Boost and unlock a Body Type for your MyPLAYER. 

Once you have done all 12 unique workouts in the Gatorade Gym, you will unlock Workout Warrior, which gives you 99 Stamina, a permanent Turbo Meter Boost, and all of your unlocked Body Types across all new and existing saves.

In [i]NBA 2K24[/i], the Acceleration attribute determined your dribble launching and off-ball movement. In contrast, [i]NBA 2K25[/i] dribble launching is now determined solely by the Speed With Ball attribute, while defensive lateral movement, off-ball launches, and off-ball cuts are determined by a new attribute called Agility.

[h1]TAKEOVERS[/h1]

[i]NBA 2K25[/i] introduces a brand new Takeover system, with 72 Takeovers and 14 Takeover Abilities. Each Takeover targets different attributes and has five levels, ranging from Level 1 when you're just heating up, to Level 5 when you're red-hot. As you excel on the court, your Takeover Meter fills up, gradually boosting the targeted attributes as you rise up the five levels. This happens automatically, so you don't need to manually activate Takeover. But if you make mistakes and produce bad plays on the court, your Takeover Meter will drop.

At Level 5, you'll trigger a Takeover Ability that, when used effectively, can make you the most dominant player on the court for a short period of time. Initially, you will only have access to Levels 1-3. You will unlock Levels 4 and 5 each by activating its previous Level in 30 different games; Takeover Level unlocks do carry over between saves!

Each Takeover has attribute requirements, and you'll be able to see which Takeovers you have the potential to unlock within the MyPLAYER Builder, as well as how each one’s associated boosts will impact your attributes. You can change your Takeover at any time between games, selecting from any that you meet the attribute requirements for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/3aa0b1c74988066fcb8b91dbf67f98021e0416a9.gif[/img]

A personal favorite of Visual Concepts is the BBQ Chicken Takeover. Hoop heads know that BBQ Chicken means you’re about to cook your defender and serve up a highlight. As your Takeover Meter rises, your post game becomes stronger. The Takeover Ability it comes with is Deep Post Bag, which temporarily, and greatly, enhances all things post — from backdowns, to post moves, and post shots.

[h1]BADGES[/h1]

There are 40 skill Badges in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] and, similar to Takeovers, each Badge has unique attribute requirements. When you're building your MyPLAYER, you'll be able to see which Badges you have the potential to unlock. These 40 Badges are split across two Tiers, determined by your MyPLAYER's height.

MyPLAYER Badges are progressed by activating each Badge in games. This means Badges you use the most will be earned more quickly, matching your playstyle on the court. This progression can only increase and does not drop even if you don't fire a Badge off. Tier 1 Badges are the most powerful Badges available to you, but are more difficult to progress compared to Tier 2 Badges. You can also work on your Badges in the Team Practice Facility.

Here's a full list of new and changed Badges in [i]NBA 2K25[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/5dd66a7a50ac678eec9d9745f7b8b88511b26423.jpg[/img]

Our goal was to make every Badge feel valuable and equally desirable. With fewer Badges, each is more all-encompassing, having a legitimate impact on the court. We ensured every area of basketball was complemented with useful Badges, so every play style has ways to stand out. This means there are fewer Badges that activate in only very specific situations. For example, Shifty Shooter covers all off-the-dribble shooting, and Set Shot Specialist covers all standing shooting.

There's also a brand new level of Badges—higher than Hall of Fame—called Legend! Legend Badges have the highest attribute requirements to unlock for your MyPLAYER but give you a huge boost on the court.

[h3]Badge Perks[/h3]

There are three new Badge Perks that can modify progression of individual Badges. Each perk has two slots available to unlock: one for Tier 1 Badges and another for Tier 2 Badges.
[list]
[*] [b]Max +1[/b] - Boost a Badge 1 level above its max potential. You must progress a Badge to its max potential before equipping this perk. These are unlocked at Level 15 (Tier 2 Badge) and Level 30 (Tier 1 Badge) in each Season. At the end of the Season, your Badges equipped with Max +1 will revert to their original level.
[*] [b]Participation[/b] - Badges equipped with this perk will earn a flat base amount of progression each game, regardless of how many times they are activated. 
[*] [b]Synergy[/b] - Badges equipped with this perk will receive progression when your teammates earn progression using the same Badge.
[/list]
Participation, Synergy, and Overdrive (returning from 2K24) are earned through rotating Season rewards. 

[h3]Performance Multipliers[/h3]

Maximize your Badges in [i]NBA 2K25[/i] by taking advantage of Performance Multipliers. These in-game boosts can take your game to another level, but you’ll need to earn them separately via Quests. There are three Performance Multipliers in total: 
[list]
[*] [b]Up For The Challenge[/b] - Games played against tough opponents boosts badge progression for all badges that are used in the game.
[*] [b]Grade A Student[/b] - Finishing games with an A-, A, or A+ boosts badge progression for all badges that are used in the game.
[*] [b]Winner's Circle[/b] - Winning games boosts badge progression for all badges that are used in the game.
[/list]
As you compete in different game types you’ll experience different versions of a Performance Multiplier based on the format. 

[h3]Badge Elevators[/h3]

New in [i]NBA 2K25[/i], Badge Elevators can permanently boost an individual Badge of your choice up to 3 levels within its max potential. For example, if your Badge is currently at Bronze but has a max potential of Legend, it can immediately be boosted up to three levels from Bronze, to Silver, to Gold, to Hall of Fame.

These will be available to unlock throughout the year from Season Level rewards. Badge Elevators earned in Seasons 1-4 can boost your Badges up to two levels, and those earned in Seasons 5-8 can boost your Badges up to three levels.

[h1]CAP BREAKERS[/h1]

Last but not least, we are excited to introduce Cap Breakers in [i]NBA 2K25[/i].

We saw community feedback that players wanted a way to not only increase attribute ratings above their max potential ‘caps’ set at build creation, but also have those ratings contribute towards Animation, Badge, and Takeover attribute requirements. That’s exactly what Cap Breakers do.

For example, let’s say your Ball Handle attribute is maxed out at 85. You can apply two Cap Breakers to play with an 87 Ball Handle rating and also unlock access to any Animations, Badges, or Takeovers that require an 87 Ball Handle.

There’s a few restrictions to ensure a balanced gameplay experience:
[list]
[*] Each attribute can be increased a maximum of +5 above its cap.
[*] You can use a Cap Breaker on an attribute up to its max potential rating allowed by your build’s height, weight, and wingspan, which is shown in the MyPLAYER Builder while allocating your attribute potential.
[*] You must progress an attribute to its max potential rating before applying a Cap Breaker.
[/list]
There are a total of 15 Cap Breakers available to earn through REP rewards. More on REP, Affiliations, and The City in a few weeks!

[h1]MyCAREER[/h1]

Once you've built your "MP," it's time to start your MyCAREER.

[i]NBA 2K25[/i]’s MyCAREER centers around constructing the greatest dynasty in NBA history, challenging you to surpass Michael Jordan’s Chicago Bulls, the ‘80s Showtime Lakers, the ‘Big 3’ Celtics starring Larry Bird, Kevin McHale, and Robert Parish, the dynamic duo of Kobe and Shaq, the high-powered Golden State Warriors featuring Steph Curry and Kevin Durant, and so on.

[h3]Heart of a Dynasty[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/bd013b62f86e8eb5e89ba2261a9fb82fef863009.jpg[/img]

At the start of your MyCAREER, you can experience MP's backstory by playing through a flashback story called Heart of a Dynasty, where you’ll relive the four most pivotal games from your path to the NBA. These include a Club League Showcase Game, your high school championship game, the FIBA u19 World Cup, and an open run with NBA players (where one of those players isn’t too happy MP got an invite).

Completing these games unlocks the MyPOINTS Accelerator, which increases your MyPOINTS progression by 5% to help you unlock new attribute upgrades more quickly. You can also choose to skip this backstory and complete it later while progressing through your NBA career.

[h3]Dynasty Rankings[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/8ffb25d6cf6a563032dd8a9738685c6542acc671.jpg[/img]

The GOAT Rankings system returns to track your ascent through the ranks of NBA legends, but we’ve added a Dynasty component on top of that where the focus is less on your individual accomplishments and more on how far you can take your team. We’ve ranked the nine greatest dynasties in NBA history, and as you make deep playoff runs and win championships, you’ll see your team climb the Dynasty Rankings until you reach the #1 spot, dethroning Michael Jordan’s Chicago Bulls.

This year’s MyPLAYER doesn’t come in with GOAT hype, so you’ll have to earn your spot in the starting lineup. The better the player in front of you is, the harder it’ll be to take his spot. But that’s just the first obstacle you’ll face as you try to build your dynasty.

[h3]Improved Key Games[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/f240ff2d2a16d68589b0404af3be29d97d73f5cf.jpg[/img]

Key Games are back and we’re really excited about the improvements we’ve made to this feature! 

This year you’ve got a ton of control over what Key Games you play. We’ve split the season into two halves, and each half you’ll set Personal Goals with your Coach and GM. Choosing different Personal Goals will give you a different set of Key Games.
			
If you like trying to outperform your matchups, you can do that. We’ve tiered it so if you have a low Overall Rating you’ll go up against other NBA players with similar ratings. If you’re a 99 Overall, you’ll go up against the best of the best. You can try to win the NBA Cup, focus on winning road games, prove you’re one of the top rookies in your class, and much more. We’ve even got a set of Key Games that revolves around posterizing guys.

You’ll have different Key Games available to you depending on your MyPLAYER Build, how good your team is, and how high your Overall Rating is. There’s content for all kinds of play styles and scenarios.

When you successfully complete your Key Games, you’ll earn Dynasty Badges that you can use to help your teammates play better in different ways. For example, Taking Over allows your team to start the game with Takeover against rival teams. Altogether, there are 18 Dynasty Badges available, with Bronze, Silver, and Gold rarities for you to unlock. Take a look below at the full list:
[list]
[*] Rapid Boil
[*] Dime Droppers
[*] Up and Coming
[*] Home Court Advantage
[*] Interior Menace
[*] King of the Hill
[*] Up and Coming
[*] Taking Over
[*] Road Heroes
[*] Helping Hand
[*] Thou Shall Not Pass
[*] Board Beasts
[*] Everybody Eats
[*] Finishing Touch
[*] Paint Protectors
[*] Get After It
[*] The Postmen
[*] Flame Throwers
[/list]
Overall, [i]NBA 2K25[/i] MyCAREER stays true to basketball, while a variety of new Quests allow you to focus on whichever aspects you find most interesting on your path to stardom. Between games, you'll meet with your agent on endorsement opportunities, participate in press conferences and podcasts to build yourself and your dynasty up, and more.

[h1]CLOSING REMARKS[/h1]

[i]NBA 2K25[/i] is filled with surprises, and we don’t want to spoil them all, but we do want to share a few of our favorites before we let you go.
[list]
[*] FIBA games are available via Heart of Dynasty, and they’ve also been added as part of the revamped Offseason flow, where you can play friendlies, qualifiers, and a full FIBA Tournament that you can recruit other NBA stars for.
[*] Swap jerseys with some of your favorite NBA superstars! Through optional Highlight Games, you can earn a jersey swap with players like Jalen Brunson and Victor Wembanyama if you complete in-game challenges against their teams. You’re going to want to earn these jerseys—not only will you be able to wear them around The City, but you can also display them in your MyCOURT (more on that in a few weeks!).
[*] After a long and storied Hall-of-Fame career, you’ll receive the coveted Naismith Hall of Fame Orange Jacket for your MyPLAYER, which you can take to The City to flex your legendary career.
[*] Finally, we are excited to announce that Season XP can now be earned from NBA career games, so you can level up and earn rewards for The City and MyTEAM! Stay tuned for more information on NBA 2K25 Seasons & Season Pass.
[/list]
[i]NBA 2K25[/i] boasts exciting new features, enhancements to your favorite modes and gameplay elements, and more. To learn more about the various gameplay improvements and expanded ProPLAY animations, visit the official [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2878980/view/4337614262850909035]Courtside Report[/url]. In the coming weeks, stay tuned for more Courtside Reports, news, and updates regarding [i]NBA 2K25[/i]’s competitive modes!

notes.title: Courtside Report: GAMEPLAY Powered by ProPLAY™
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GgsisvYf3eA;full][/previewyoutube]

Elevate your NBA 2K25 game on PC with ProPLAY™, the future of sports-sim technology. ProPLAY takes authentic movements from actual NBA footage and translates them into engaging, immersive gameplay. This year, we’re bringing you even closer to the action, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

[h1]Gameplay, Powered by ProPLAY™[/h1]

NBA 2K24 welcomed new innovations and enhancements to the NBA 2K franchise, introducing the next generation of groundbreaking realism via ProPLAY™. For NBA 2K25, we expanded on ProPLAY’s animations, revamped the dribbling engine, and improved the gameplay on both offense and defense.

[h3]ProPLAY™ Animation Expansion[/h3]

ProPLAY™ is realized in an even greater way in NBA 2K25. Using new ProPLAY™ animations, which have been directly translated from real-world NBA footage, gameplay becomes even more authentic as we replace traditional motion-captured animations with ProPLAY™ animations.

We've added 9,000 new ProPLAY™ animations in NBA 2K25, including 1,500 dribbling animations, 1,100 signature shot animations covering most rostered players from the 2023-24 NBA season, and over 1,300 new off-the-ball animations, including 150 new signature motion styles.

[h3]All-New Dribble Engine[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/3466c2569629d944c0988c642726e6ade0bb5d8e.gif[/img]

NBA 2K25 features an all-new dribble engine built from the ground up. This is the biggest change to our gameplay engine in many years and we’re eager for you to test it yourself. In every previous version of NBA 2K, dribble movement was managed by manually programmed, pre-scripted animation transitions from a library of motion-captured movements.

Now, with the power of ProPLAY™, NBA 2K25's dribble engine generates dynamic motion from real-world NBA footage to create a new and more authentic feel. It goes beyond animations, and turns movement with the ball into one holistic, dynamic piece of motion, one-to-one with how players dribble in real life. Stops are tighter, launches are more explosive, and probing the court looks and feels smoother, more lifelike, and more consistent than ever before. We can’t wait for you to experience this first-hand.

[h1]OFFENSE[/h1]

NBA 2K25 provides more variety, accessibility, and freedom on offense for newcomers, seasoned players, and full-blown experts alike with all-new improvements like the Shot Canceling feature, Signature Go-To Shots, Shot Timing Profiles, Pro Stick Rhythm Shooting, and more.

[h3]Signature Go-To Shots[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/5688a9b511ce4a8ef346b8da1a0eba6f6ef81996.gif[/img]

With NBA 2K24, we introduced Dribble Breakdowns to initiate a sequence of signature size-up moves that you can use to create separation and breakdown the defender. In NBA 2K25 we took this concept a bit further. Holding UP on the Pro Stick will trigger Signature Go-To Shots which feature some of the most exciting dribble-into-shot combos, directly translated from NBA footage—another feature driven by ProPLAY™ technology.

[h3]Shot Canceling Feature[/h3]

We're also implementing a new Shot Canceling feature that lets you break out of any advanced shot at any time to transition into other moves, like a more robust hesi or shot fake. Coupled with Signature Go-To Shots, the ProPLAY™ Dribble Movement Engine, and expanded ProPLAY™ Animations, this free-flowing experience allows you to start a stepback jumper, cancel out of the shot, and move into a different dribble move, or take a driving lane to the basket.

These improvements give offensive players more tools to be creative.

[h3]Shot Timing Profiles[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/a4d051b2f91f40d19a2816291bcb0b3d01ddaa83.jpg[/img]

We received feedback from opposite ends of the spectrum on shooting this past year. Some players loved the added challenge, while others found shooting to be too difficult, especially for newcomers. In NBA 2K25, we've added a new setting called Shot Timing Profiles that allows you to customize the risk-versus-reward of your shot timing.

Choosing "Low Risk-Reward" will provide more forgiving shot timing that emphasizes ratings, openness, and taking smart shots over the release of the button or stick. A mistimed shot could still go in but the green make window will be smaller, making it more difficult to consistently have excellent-timed releases.

Choosing "High Risk-Reward" will offer more challenging shot timing with green-or-miss outcomes. If you're consistently good at timing your shot, you're sure to reap big rewards by choosing this option.

[h3]Custom Visual Cues[/h3]

NBA 2K24 added the Shot Timing Visual Cue setting to select your ideal jump shot release point from Jump, Set Point, Push, or Release animation cues. In NBA 2K25’s MyPLAYER Jump Shot Creator, you are no longer limited to these four options. After selecting a base, release, and release speed for your custom jump shot, you can now set your Visual Cue to any point in the shot, giving you full customization over when to release the shot button or stick.

[h3]Pro Stick Rhythm Shooting[/h3]

While all shooting control methods from NBA 2K24 are returning, NBA 2K25 introduces a brand new way to shoot called Pro Stick Rhythm Shooting. Instead of simply pressing and releasing the shot button or stick, you first pull the shot stick DOWN to start the shot. Then, as you see your player's jump shot animation reach its Set Point, you push the shot stick UP and try to match the timing and speed of the player's Push motion. This intuitive DOWN-UP motion on the shot stick rewards you for accurately mimicking each player's signature shooting motion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/410536b8b742029d550299d925761f13df1dc477.jpg[/img]

A player who masters Rhythm Shooting will raise their ceiling and outplay someone who uses traditional shooting, creating more possibilities to demonstrate your skills. Your selected Shot Timing Profile also applies to Rhythm Shooting, allowing you to choose a Low or High Risk-Reward experience as detailed further up. We encourage you to give it a try! When we first introduced Rhythm Shooting to the rest of the team here at Visual Concepts, many thought it was a bit too challenging. However, those of us who kept practicing grew to love it and now can't go back to traditional shooting. We've also seen our shooting percentages rise significantly as we've improved with the mechanic.

With Shot Timing Profiles, Custom Visual Cues, Signature Go-To Shots, and the new Pro Stick Rhythm Shooting, NBA 2K25 gives you ultimate customization over how you shoot the ball.

[h1]DEFENSE[/h1]

Take advantage of all-new defensive measures that’ll impact your ability to lockdown opponents, and be sure to visit Learn 2K to improve on the fundamentals.

[h3]Defensive Movement System[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/f169291e6270315031c865e6f84ae9453b66cda5.gif[/img]

NBA 2K25 features a brand new defensive cutoff system. Offensive players have long been able to dynamically change direction using the right stick, and savvy defensive players can now do the same. 

By utilizing the right stick on defense, you can control your player and quickly slide laterally into position to cut off an offensive player’s attack. Successfully reading the ball handler and anticipating their drive with a successful cutoff can stonewall the offense or cause them to fumble the ball.

[h3]Contest System[/h3]

For NBA 2K25, we made significant changes to the Contest System. We now use a dynamic weighting system, rather than a fixed one, that evaluates the impact of defense at the start of the shot versus the release and computes the proper coverage impact accordingly. 

In addition, you’ll notice that perimeter and interior defensive ratings, as well as height differential, play a more important role in calculating defensive coverage. These changes better reflect what you see happening on screen and reward your strong defensive sequences to decrease the competition's chances of converting their shots. 

[h1]AI GAMEPLAY[/h1]

To make AI play a more complementary role in NBA 2K25, we made improvements to Court Spacing, Offense, Defense, Coaching, and the AI Difficulty to elevate your overall experience. Take a look at some of the key changes below:

[h3]COURT SPACING[/h3]
[list]
[*] Our new spacing engine has over 20 adjustment locations from inside the 3-point line that feeds AI a constant stream of spacing information yielding life-like results.
[*] Individual freelance has also been redesigned to account for this new spacing engine.
[*] This extends to the tech that drives AI double team reactions to increase the priority of spacing during double teams.
[/list]
[h3]OFFENSE[/h3]
[list]
[*] We revamped our cut to basket logic for the AI to lessen untimely cuts to the rim in freelance by your AI teammates, leading to better driving lanes and drive and kick opportunities.
[/list]
[h3]DEFENSE[/h3]
[list]
[*] A redesign of our defensive help logic, allowing for better pursuit angles and rotations.
[/list]
[h3]COACHING[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players now have the ability to save and share their playbooks with the NBA 2K community!
[/list]
[h3]AI DIFFICULTY[/h3]
[list]
[*] AI difficulty is now based on more than just shooting percentages. Lower difficulties will experience less aggressive offense and defense, and make fewer strategy changes or adjustments.
[*] We scaled on-ball defensive delays per difficulty so attacking the basket on lower-level AI is easier, including increased body-up win resolutions for easier blow-bys.
[/list]
[h1]LEARN 2K[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/6f77cac97971e35b9dcca40ccea4ad09326ce7e9.jpg[/img]

Now that you’ve learned about all of the gameplay enhancements and expanded ProPLAY™ features, it’s time to get hands on and practice. Whether you want to try out the new Rhythm Shooting or learn the hundreds of moves in NBA 2K25, the new Learn 2K mode, accessible from the Main Menu, provides mini-games, drills, and practice scenarios to help you up your game. Playing NBA 2K on the sticks can be as simple or as complex as you want it to be. 

[h1]CLOSING REMARKS[/h1]

The Visual Concepts team worked tirelessly to make all of the gameplay changes in New Gen NBA 2K25 feel rewarding and intuitive for all experience levels, while keeping our passionate fanbase in mind. We’re so excited to see clips from the NBA 2K community utilizing all of the new enhancements and features available in NBA 2K25.

Be on the lookout for even more news and information in the coming weeks regarding all things  NBA 2K25. For now, I’m Mike Wang—thanks for showing your support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099431/1451cde450af0933d06479e524dc9e0f50e32633.png[/img]

notes.content:
[h3]Stack wins, raise banners, and make history in [i]NBA 2K25[/i].[/h3]

The New Gen version of [i]NBA 2K25[/i] is now supported on PC. Powered by enhanced ProPLAY™ technology, New Gen [i]NBA 2K25[/i] delivers the franchise’s most true-to-life basketball experience yet, offering players the ultimate control in how they dominate the competition. Players on PC with compatible specs will now benefit from the enhanced realism of ProPLAY™ technology, and the ability to compete in modes such as MyNBA, The W and in The City.
